### Initial settings + load packages:
```{r message = F}
library(tidyverse)
library(p8105.datasets)

knitr::opts_chunk$set(
  fig.width = 6,
  fig.asp = .6,
  out.width = "90%"
)

theme_set(theme_minimal() + theme(legend.position = "bottom"))

options(
  ggplot2.continuous.colour = "viridis",
  ggplot2.continuous.fill = "viridis"
)

scale_colour_discrete = scale_color_viridis_d
scale_fill_discrete = scale_fill_viridis_d
```

# Problem 1

Loading dataset:
```{r}
data("ny_noaa")
```


Data cleaning:
```{r}
ny_noaa_df =
  ny_noaa |> 
  mutate(month = lubridate::month(date), year = lubridate::year(date), day = lubridate::day(date),
         prcp = prcp/100, snow = snow/10, snwd = snwd/10, 
         tmax = as.numeric(tmax), tmin = as.numeric(tmin),
         tmax = tmax/10, tmin = tmin/10)
```

* Separate `date` variable into `month`, `day`, `year` variables
* Converting `prcp`, `snow`, and `snwd` into centimeters
* Converting `tmax` and `tmin` from character to numeric
* Converting `tmax` and `tmin` from tenth of degrees C into degrees C

This dataset has `r nrow(ny_noaa_df)` observations and `r ncol(ny_noaa_df)` variables once dates are parsed out into month, day, and year separately. It is describing precipitation and temperature across several weather stations and dates across `r nrow(distinct(ny_noaa_df, year))` years. There are `r sum(is.na(ny_noaa_df))` missing values across the whole dataset, which is quite a bit.


For snowfall, what are the most commonly observed values? 
```{r}
ny_noaa_df |> 
  group_by(snow) |> 
  summarize(n_obs = n())
```
The most commonly observed values are 

Two-panel plot showing average max temperature in January and in July: 
```{r}
ny_noaa_df |> 
  filter(month == 1 | month == 7) |> 
  group_by(id, month, year) |> 
  summarize(mean_tmax = mean(tmax, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = year, y = mean_tmax)) +
  geom_point(alpha = .25) +
  facet_grid(. ~ month) +
  labs(
    title = "Temperature plot",
    x = "year",
    y = "Average max temperature (C)"
  )
```

Two-panel plot showing tmax vs tmin for the full dataset:
```{r}
ny_noaa_df |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = tmax, y = tmin)) +
  geom_smooth(se = FALSE)
```

Plot showing distribution of snowfall values greater than 0 and less than 100 separately by year:
```{r}
ny_noaa_df |> 
  filter(0 < snow & snow < 100) |> 
  group_by(year) |> 
  summarize(avg_snow = mean(snow, na.rm = TRUE)) |> 
  ggplot(aes(x = avg_snow)) +
  geom_histogram()
```
